title: Check a cached hosted image
responsibility: Decodes a cached image, checks its size and hash, and passes it to the image validator.

inputs.name: hostedImage.value
inputs.description: The cached hosted image value to decode. Only strings are accepted; they are decoded as base64, and the resulting bytes must be at most 25,000,000 bytes, match `sha256`, and pass PNG validation.
inputs.unknownReason: The cache can return an arbitrary value, and the decoder accepts only bounded and verified image bytes.

inputs.name: hostedImage.sha256
inputs.description: The expected digest for the decoded bytes. It is compared exactly with the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest produced from those bytes.

outputs.name: hostedImage
outputs.description: The decoded image as the same Uint8Array passed through ImageBytesValidator. The validator requires a complete PNG with nonzero dimensions and at most 32,000,000 pixels; the hosted-image 25,000,000-byte cap is applied first.

errors.name: InvalidHostedImageError
errors.description: Throws InvalidHostedImageError('Invalid cached image.') when value is not a string. Throws InvalidHostedImageError('Hosted image hash mismatch.') when decoded bytes exceed 25,000,000 bytes or their lowercase SHA-256 digest differs; ImageBytesValidator also propagates Errors for invalid PNG data or its size and dimension limits.
